en.askTitle: Swap in your own group, dates and budget and get the same east-coast Jeju plan, with the car-or-bus question checked first
en.runTitle: Seoul to Jeju: three friends, three days, about KRW 600,000 each

fields.label: Travellers, ages, licences and mobility needs
fields.value: Three friends in their mid-20s, travelling from Seoul

fields.label: Dates and flight times
fields.value: Fly in on Friday 1 October 2027, fly out on the evening of Sunday 3 October 2027

fields.label: Budget and exclusions
fields.value: About KRW 600,000 per person, excluding flights

en.template: Plan east-coast Jeju for {travellers} on {dates}, with {budget}. Compare eligible all-in car/insurance quotes with a realistic bus route, price rooms for the actual group, and keep sunrise, rain and airport-return alternatives. Separate dated samples from confirmed quotes. Plan only; do not book, contact anyone, create accounts or pay.

phases.title: Check holidays, car and bus prices, and where to stay
phases.note: Chuseok dates, rental and fuel prices, official bus fares, a few east-coast rooms and cafés
phases.judgment: It checked who can actually rent the car before relying on the price: the quote it found needs a driver aged 26 or over who has held a licence for more than a year, which friends in their mid-20s may not meet. So the plan keeps a bus version beside the car one.

phases.title: Build the day-by-day plan and a budget that adds up
phases.note: Sunrise, coast, Olle trail, rainy-day option and a cost table
phases.judgment: Hotel prices are shown as dated examples, not quotes. The cheapest option it found was a price for two adults, not three, so the guide says to price a three-person room first and claims no rate for October 2027.

workers: Looked for three places to stay on the east side with prices shown publicly, plus black-pork meals and café prices
Checked car-rental prices and who is allowed to rent, the fuel price, and official bus fares and routes

zh.askTitle: 换成你们自己的人数、日期和预算，得到同样的济州东海岸方案，并先查清谁能租车
zh.runTitle: 首尔到济州：三位朋友三天，每人约 60 万韩元

fields.label: 人数、年龄、驾照和行动需求
fields.value: 三位 20 代中期的朋友，从首尔出发

fields.label: 日期及航班时间
fields.value: 2027 年 10 月 1 日（周五）飞到，10 月 3 日（周日）晚上飞走

fields.label: 预算及不包含项目
fields.value: 每人约 60 万韩元，不含机票

zh.template: 请按{travellers}、{dates}、{budget}规划济州东海岸。比较符合资格的租车保险全包价和现实公交路线，按实际人数询房，保留日出、雨天和回机场替代安排。分清有日期的示例与确认报价。只做规划，不预订、不联系、不开户、不付款。

phases.title: 核对假期、租车与公交价格，以及住哪里
phases.note: 中秋日期、租车和油价、官方公交票价、几家东海岸的住处和咖啡馆
phases.judgment: 它先查清谁能租车，再看价格：找到的报价要求司机 26 岁以上、持驾照满一年，20 代中期的朋友未必符合。所以方案在自驾之外保留了一套公交版本。

phases.title: 做出逐日行程和对得上的预算
phases.note: 日出、海岸、Olle 步道、雨天备案和费用表
phases.judgment: 住宿价格只当作带日期的示例，不是报价。找到的最低价是两位成人的价格，不是三人的，所以文中让大家先问三人房的价格，也没有给出 2027 年 10 月的任何房价。

workers: 找出三处东边可住的地方（价格公开可查），以及黑猪肉餐厅和咖啡馆的价格
查租车价格和谁有资格租、油价，以及官方公交票价和路线
